name: MarketMind AI – Intelligent Market Research Pipeline
description: Multi-agent market research workflow using IBM Granite via IBM watsonx.ai + RAG

input_value.value: Analyze the Indian Electric Vehicle market

node.documentation: Enter a market, product, or company to analyze

system_message.value: You are an expert market research analyst. Generate structured JSON market analysis including market size, growth rate, key players, drivers, challenges, and executive summary.

node.description: Research Agent – IBM Granite market intelligence gathering
node.documentation: Calls IBM Granite via watsonx.ai to gather market intelligence

node.description: RAG Agent – document retrieval from indexed knowledge base
node.documentation: Retrieves relevant chunks from uploaded documents using FAISS vector search

system_message.value: You are a competitive intelligence analyst. Analyze competitors in the given market and return structured JSON with market share, strengths, weaknesses, and positioning for each player.

node.description: Competitor Analysis Agent – IBM Granite competitive intelligence
node.documentation: Maps competitive landscape with strengths, weaknesses, and market positioning

system_message.value: You are a customer sentiment analyst. Analyze customer sentiment for the given market/product and return JSON with positive/neutral/negative percentages, key themes, and NPS score.

node.description: Sentiment Analysis Agent – customer voice analysis
node.documentation: Analyzes customer reviews and feedback to extract sentiment metrics

system_message.value: You are a market trends analyst. Identify emerging trends, historical patterns, technology shifts, and demand trends for the given market. Return structured JSON.

node.description: Market Trend Agent – emerging trends and historical pattern analysis
node.documentation: Identifies emerging trends, historical patterns, and technology shifts

system_message.value: You are a predictive analytics expert. Based on provided trend data, generate market size forecasts, demand predictions, scenario analysis (best/base/worst case), opportunities, and risks. Always include AI disclaimer. Return JSON.

node.description: Predictive Insights Agent – market forecasting and scenario analysis
node.documentation: Generates 5-year market forecasts and scenario analysis using IBM Granite

system_message.value: You are a senior business intelligence consultant. Compile all research data into a professional executive report with executive summary, key findings, strategic recommendations, and conclusion. Return structured JSON.

node.description: Report Generation Agent – executive summary and business intelligence report
node.documentation: Compiles all agent outputs into a comprehensive BI report

node.description: Final research output with all agent results
node.documentation: Returns complete market research JSON for dashboard rendering

metadata.description: MarketMind AI – Multi-agent market research pipeline
